bio: In one of the liveliest and most popular areas of the historic center, off a side street of Via Toledo, you'll find classic Neapolitan pizzas, including some unique creations such as an eight-pointed star-shaped pizza. Established in 1938 and now in its third generation, Da Attilio has a few tables spread across two small rooms. Since they don't take reservations, you might have to wait during peak times....
